title: Add img.decode() API for "predecoding" images
body:
Add img.decode() API for "predecoding" images

This API alllows the author to request that the user agent decode the
image, preferably off the main thread, so that when the returned promise
fulfills, the image is ready to be inserted into the document, without
causing dropped frames due to decoding delay.

Notable design choices made:

- Rejects for non-active documents (or documents that become non-active)
- Immediately fulfills for vector graphics or other formats that do not
  require decoding
- Fulfills for animated images after all of their frames are loaded, not
  just the first, ensuring jank-free animation

Closes #2037.

This also includes the editorial change of giving a <dfn> to the "update
the rendering" step, and linking to it where it is mentioned.

----

Original PR conversation follows:

/cc @junov @vmpstr @smfr.

@zcorpan I could use your help on whether I'm integrating with the img element's processing model right. Particularly the stuff around current and pending request; I should maybe be handling those more/differently. Also curious about using terms like "main thread" and "frame" and "decode" which are not terribly well-defined. Concrete phrasing suggestions welcome.

---

Remaining TODOs:

- [x] [Call out how to handle SVG images specifically](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/2332#discussion_r99989045). This is tied to the next point.
- [x] [Figure out how the width/height attributes play into the decoding process](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/2332#discussion_r99989045). Does decode mean "rasterize to the current value of width/height"?
- [ ] [Figure out the task source to use for the promise queuing](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/2332#discussion_r100039933), maybe
- [x] [Figure out if we allow decoding before setting src](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/2332#issuecomment-278340401)
- [x] [Figure out if we allow decoding to re-start due to srcset/picture changes](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/2332#issuecomment-278340401) (decision: let's not)
- [x] [Decide whether we want to cache the promise so that decode() returns the same promise as long as the decoded image isn't evicted](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/2332#discussion_r100098021) (Tentative decision: let's not do this.)

Test cases:

- It works and fulfills for a normal image
- It works and fulfills for an SVG image
- It rejects for an image whose dimensions cannot be determined
- It rejects for an image whose dimensions can be determined but which cannot be encoded
- It returns a new promise each time (this might change; see above)
- It rejects if you cause the srcset/picture machinery to start a new image load while decoding is happening
- It rejects if you change the src attribute while decoding is happening
- It rejects if used on a src-less image (this might change; see above)
